identity: Hearthpine cuts the pit props for the Copperfell shafts; this year the woods bite back, and a gang of ore thieves under a chief called Bracket is carting off what the shift digs.

quests.title: Let Them Rest
quests.text: I know a dragging footstep after a hard shift, and those aren't tired miners. Lay three Pit Shufflers to rest after dark on the shore at the {name:shingle}, {dir_from_giver:shingle}. Whatever shift they think they're working, it has gone on long enough.

variants.text: Dune grass bends beneath a living foot and rises after it; the dead leave it no such quiet. Lay three Dune Stumblers to rest after dark on the {name:strand}, {dir_from_giver:strand}. Let the waves be the only thing that returns to that shore without tiring.

The Sun-Dried Husks still drag themselves along the shore as though thirst could follow them past death. Put three to rest after dark on the {name:strand}, {dir_from_giver:strand}. Whatever they were, they have crawled through enough salt.

Listen among the roots after dark: rats scurry, but Root Shufflers drag their feet. Lay three to rest at night in the {name:rootways}, which lie {zone_area:rootways}. Nobody should wander forever without knowing which doorway is home.

I have read the burial rolls aloud to the Nameless Shufflers, and not one turned its head. Lay three to rest in the {name:ashfields}, which lie {zone_area:ashfields}, by day or night. The blight shelters them from the sun; waiting for morning will not give them back their names.

quests.lesson: A night target at a third of the day count.

quests.title: The Feast Fights Back
quests.text: For once I'd like a supper nobody can mistake for yesterday's stew. Bring me two Crab Legs from Pebble Crabs or Boulder Crabs by day at the {name:rockpools}, {dir_from_giver:rockpools}. The Pebble Crabs wait for you to start trouble; the Boulder Crabs have no such manners, so mind your fingers.

variants.text: Even an ancient recipe needs someone willing to get their boots wet. Bring me two Crab Legs from Sand Fiddlers by day on the {name:strand}, {dir_from_giver:strand}. The crabs leave you alone until you strike, which gives you time to choose something more promising than the one already escaping into the water.

Supper is scuttling about while I stand here with an empty pot. Bring me two Crab Legs from Fiddler Crabs or Sand Snappers by day on the shore at the {name:saltflats}, {dir_from_giver:saltflats}. The Fiddler Crabs wait for the first blow; the Sand Snappers are less patient than my hungry hunters.

A feast needs Crab Legs, and I refuse to count the guests' legs as a substitute. Bring me two from the Fiddler Crabs by day in the {name:shallows}, {dir_from_giver:shallows}. Choose your crab before you start waving your hands; it will wait, and I would like the same number of fingers helping with supper.

For once, my shopping can be done in daylight. Bring me two Crab Legs from Ghost Crabs or Bone Snappers on the shore at the {name:saltbones}, {dir_from_giver:saltbones}. The Ghost Crabs will wait to be provoked, while the Bone Snappers would happily make a meal of the shopper.

quests.lesson: Shore loot by day; keep what your enchants need.

quests.title: A Hard Hat Has Limits
quests.text: Ibex Kids are kicking slate onto the paths, and the miners have begun looking up instead of where they're going. Hunt eight by day among the {name:high_pines}, which lie {zone_area:high_pines}; they graze peaceably until you start it. Our skulls are sturdy, but I'd rather not test them against the whole hillside.
quests.lesson: A local hunt; the head armor choice (one enchant, item level 5).

quests.title: Bracket Doesn't Add Up
quests.text: {name:muddled_ore_chief} has written our ore into his ledger as though stealing it were a trade. Go to the {name:ore_thief_camp}, {dir_from_giver:ore_thief_camp}, and defeat seven Ore Thieves and their chief; they hold it day and night. Draw Bracket away from his crew if you can; I'd like his ledger closed without your name entered in it.
quests.completion: Bracket's sums finally add up to nothing, and our miners can keep what they dig. Hearthpine will remember the work you've done here. When you're ready for a longer road, come and have a word with me.
quests.lesson: A camp pack plus a named leader; the weapon choice (prefix and suffix).

quests.title: Follow the Missing Ore
quests.text: You put an end to Bracket's stealing, but his carts already took our ore to Copperfell. Follow the main road to Copperfell Village and tell Orrik Pineledger what happened. Finish any business here first; Hearthpine sends you off with pride, not a boot to the backside.
quests.lesson: Start to home zone handoff at level 9 to 10.
